data: Microsoft reported the larger net income for fiscal 2023: $72,361 million (about $72.4 billion) for the year ended June 30, 2023, versus $30,425 million (about $30.4 billion) for Amazon for the year ended December 31, 2023. That makes Microsoft's net income roughly 2.4 times Amazon's (72,361 ÷ 30,425 ≈ 2.38). Note that the two companies' fiscal years end at different times, so the periods are not identical, though each is the company's own fiscal 2023.
